title: What changed in the CRS project recently?

messages.content: What changed in the CRS project recently?

Everything landed on **2026-07-16** — two threads:

**CRS Brain app (UI/UX overhaul, the big push):**
- New chat surface with a **Chat / Buildprint mode switch** and mode-aware quick-action cards (8 grounded Chat + 6 Buildprint); unified "Conversations" sidebar with bp badges (old Buildprint tab retired).
- **Full-window Kanban view** (Task 1) decoupled from the map drawer.
- **Settings & Preferences** page (Task 2) — General / Appearance / Notifications / Connections tabs + SMTP.
- Shell restructure: right rail removed, usage moved to header, dashboard redesign, light/dark theme, notifications bell + inbox, live token meter.
- **Wishlist → Claude Code prompt generator** (per-item button + preview modal).
- Server: settings/theme store, notifications + email hook, live token streaming, Buildprint connection link (with a Windows-safe `cmd.exe /c` fix), Bubble watcher, smart model routing.
- Infra guardrails: `doctor.js` health check, `.gitattributes` line-ending lock, hardened `.gitignore` for secrets.

**Bubble test-branch / brain:**
- **11 users added** to the test DB (1 Hakan Dagtas + 10 across 10 departments) — no passwords, login needs invite/reset.
- Bubble sync `a297cb2b → be1670b3`: **settings/client-safe.json only** — no DTs/OS/workflows touched. **Pattern A status unchanged (still 0/46 live DTs compliant).** Re-verified security facts in `brain/security.md` (WF/GET API exposed, iframe allowed, 2FA off, no password policy, SendGrid unverified).

Open item flagged: key-level diff of `client-safe.json` wasn't recoverable in-sandbox — Vlad can approve an interactive `git diff` or a baseline copy next session.

Sources: `git log`, `brain/changelog.md:7-40`.
